form.div: One card per monitored database. The Name identifies the card and must be unique (the database name may repeat across hosts). After "Create" you get a token to paste in Settings > Perf Monitor Agent of the monitored database (recommended, module only); the root collector installer is still offered as an optional alternative.

div.name: regenerate_collector
div.div: The previous token is revoked: the collector is now getting HTTP 401 and stores nothing until the new token is in /etc/perf-monitor/collector.conf and the collector is restarted. This token is shown only once.
div.p: Monitored by perf_monitor_agent (module only)? Paste the new token in Settings > Perf Monitor Agent > New central token of the monitored database and save: nothing else to do. Root collector (legacy):

ol.li: On the monitored server, set token = <new token> in /etc/perf-monitor/collector.conf (or run the one-liner below).
Restart the collector: sudo systemctl restart perf-monitor-collector.
Confirm the pushes return 200: journalctl -u perf-monitor-collector -n 20 (no 401) and "Last seen" of this server moves within a few minutes.

details.summary: Collector not installed yet? Full install command instead

div.name: regenerate_agent
div.div: The previous token is revoked: perf_monitor_agent of this database is now getting HTTP 401 until it uses the new token. This token is shown only once.

ol.li: Paste it in Settings > Perf Monitor Agent > New central token of the monitored database (system parameter perf_monitor_agent.central_token), or re-run deploy_perf_monitor_agent.sh.
Confirm the next slow calls push returns 200 ("Last push" of this source moves).

div.name: add_done
div.div: Copy the token now: it is shown only once (only its hash is stored).
div.h3: Recommended: perf_monitor_agent module only (no root script)

ol.li: In the monitored database, install the module perf_monitor_agent.
Open Settings > Perf Monitor Agent and paste the Central URL, the Central database and the token below, then Save.
Keep "Collect DB metrics" on. Keep "Send host metrics" on in one database per host only (CPU / RAM / disk / network are the same for every database of a host).
Within 5 minutes this card shows Metrics, Top SQL, Live queries and Slow calls ("Perf Monitor: agent collect" / "Perf Monitor: agent push" crons).

details.summary: Optional / legacy: root collector install command (perf_collector.py service)
details.div: Only if you cannot install perf_monitor_agent. Run it as root on the monitored server, after replacing CHANGE_ME with the password of the read-only role perf_monitor_ro. It contains the same token.
